say.variants.default: You holding up all right? You look like you've had a rough stretch.
Got a minute to check in—how are your food, water, and bandages looking?
say.variants.positive: Glad to see you still on your feet, {addressee.name}. Need anything while we've got a quiet moment?
You're looking steadier than most folks out here. Everything holding together?
say.variants.neutral: Just checking in. Running low on clean water, food, or anything to patch up with?
How's your shape today—hungry, beat, or managing okay?
say.variants.negative: You look half-spent. Don't tell me you're fine if you're running on empty.
Rough day? Let's make sure you're not hiding a bad cut or an empty canteen.
say.variants.contextual: With the water pressure gone and the nights getting colder, how are you keeping up?
Long haul through these streets—you got enough left in the tank to keep going?
entries.reply.blocked.say.variants.default: Can't do this right now—keep your eyes up.
entries.reply.blocked.say.variants.negative: Leave it. I've got bigger problems in front of me.
entries.reply.supported.say.variants.default: Appreciate that, {addressee.name}. Knowing someone's got an eye out helps more than you'd think.
entries.reply.supported.say.variants.positive: Thanks, {addressee.name}. A little help goes a long way out here.
entries.reply.deferred.say.variants.default: Let's get somewhere with four walls first, then we'll sort out what's short.
entries.reply.deferred.say.variants.neutral: Holding steady for now. Ask me again once we're off the open road.
entries.reply.deferred.say.variants.contextual: I'll manage until dusk—just need a quiet roof and five minutes off my feet.
entries.reply.declined.say.variants.default: I'm fine. Worry about your own pack.
entries.reply.declined.say.variants.negative: Don't fuss over me. I'll handle my own business.
entries.reply.evasive.say.variants.default: Getting by well enough. No sense complaining about it.
entries.reply.evasive.say.variants.neutral: Same as everybody else—tired, hungry, still kicking.
entries.reply.accept_treatment.say.variants.defa: Alright—wrap it tight before it dirties. Appreciate you carrying clean dressing.
entries.reply.refuse_treatment.say.variants.defa: Keep your roll for someone bleeding out—I'll stitch myself later.
entries.reply.reluctant.say.variants.default: Fine, take one look, then get back on watch before anything hears us.
entries.reply.holding_up.say.variants.default: Tired to the bone, sure, but still standing and ready to move.
entries.reply.strained.say.variants.default: Running dry without tap water's wearing everyone thin, not just me.
entries.reply.dismissed.say.variants.default: Quit fussing over me. Keep your hands on your weapon.
